query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM receipt_queue AS r
                        INNER JOIN message AS m ON m.message_id = r.message_id
                        INNER JOIN chat AS c ON c.chat_id = m.chat_id
                        WHERE r.locked_by = ?1
                            AND r.status = ?2
                            AND (c.muted_until IS NULL OR c.muted_until <= ?3)
                    ) AS "read_in_unmuted_chat: bool"
